text:
Sam Brooks: Quick one — IberiaCloud SL sent invoice IC-4521 billed to Redwood EU and they've included 21% Spanish VAT but the invoice doesn't show their NIF (VAT number) or our IE VAT. They also asked if Redwood can 'gross up' to cover VAT since their margin's tight. Hold payment?

Anya Ivanov: If it's B2B (we are Redwood Ireland) they should not charge Spanish VAT. Supplier must show their NIF and our VAT number and include wording for reverse-charge. Without NIF we can't validate via VIES, so hold payment.

Diego Ramirez: I asked them to reissue invoice showing: (1) supplier NIF, (2) Redwood Ireland VAT ID (IE9876543V), and (3) "VAT to be accounted for by the recipient (reverse charge)". Told them we will delay payment until corrected invoice.

IberiaCloud (via email): "System auto-applied VAT, we can reissue but need payment this week. Can Redwood gross-up so we still receive full net?"

tax-bot: Note: Finance policy — we don't gross-up for supplier tax collection errors. Gross-up is a commercial concession and needs FP&A + legal approval. Also keep evidence of VIES check once NIF provided.

Anya Ivanov: If they insist on charging VAT and we pay, request a full credit note later. Also capture their VIES status and the invoice trail for EU VAT reclaim if applicable.

Sam Brooks: Payment-bot set a 5-business-day hold and reminder.

payment-bot: Reminder set: follow up on IC-4521 in 5 business days.

Diego Ramirez: I'll file the correspondence with AP and procurement. Will update here when reissued invoice arrives. :white_check_mark:
